page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at the top, page number 314 beside it. No marginal notes. Catchword "Abunde" at the lower right.

main_text.p: Vivam potius (cum Deceffore meo Henrico Tertio) Eleemofynis Ecclesiæ fultentatus, quàm è Præfulum & Miniftrorum ore Panem fuum violenter eripiam.

Proximum huic deinde futurum est, ad Ieroboami modum reformari: ut confecrentur è populo vilissimi Sacerdotes in Isra-el[?]; aureosque Illos vitulos colant, Ecclesiæ patrimonio, & dote locupletatos; quod quam ceffit foeliciter Principi Illi, Sacerdotibus & Populo, fatis notum eft, nec proculdubio hîc aliter futurum, si qui hactenus in Tutela erant Regum & Reginarum, qui Nutricii Patres & Matres huic semper Ecclesiæ exiterunt, ad eorum demensum vivendum habeant, qui jam satis oftenderunt, quid à se Duri Patris quid Malignæ Novercæ exspectandum.
Quod si paupertas Scotiæ crimen hîc aliquanto extenuaret, in hac tamen uberta-te & copia Anglia rapi sic proventus Ecclesiæ, nullo modo excusare licet, aut invidiam deprecari.

Ego vero nec id precari à Deo aufim, ut avertat illa à Regno & Ecclesiæ calamito-sa, quæ Miniftrorum Paritatem & Indigenam haud dubie sunt secuta: cum sic prorsus videamur vel tentare Deum, vel illudere, ea mala deprecantes quorum Causæ & Remedia sunt in noftra poteftate: cum his non uti[?] flagitium sit, illas, non devitare

page.notes: Italic type judged by eye in several places; the italic words are approximate. "Isra-el" at the line end: the hyphenated word is read as Israel, the second half is doubtful. "uti" on the last line is doubtful (printed as "sti" or "uti"). Greek running head transcribed as ΕΙΚΩΝ ΒΑΣΙΛΙΚΗ; the printed letters are close to Greek capitals and the scan is small. Opening "Vivam" is treated as the start of a paragraph, not a continuation from the previous page.
